title: TeamsGroupChat Action target binding
description: Posts a message to a Teams group chat.

TeamsGroupChatActionTargetBinding.description: Posts a message to a Teams group chat.

actionType.description: The Action type. Determines the allowed context and parameters. Must be 'TeamsGroupChat'.

TeamsGroupChatParameters.description: TeamsGroupChat parameters. chatId, headline and message are required. Parameter names must be unique, and each parameter's resolved value (all tokens concatenated) must not exceed 5000 characters, or the lower limit stated by the parameter. The service validates name uniqueness when the Action is created or imported, and the character limits when the Action runs.

TeamsGroupChatParameter.description: A named parameter of the TeamsGroupChat Action.

oneOf.title: chatId
oneOf.description: Required. Id of the Teams group chat. The resolved value (all tokens concatenated) must not exceed 100 characters. This is validated by the service when the Action runs.

oneOf.title: headline
oneOf.description: Required. Message headline. The resolved value (all tokens concatenated) must not exceed 500 characters. This is validated by the service when the Action runs.

oneOf.title: message
oneOf.description: Required. Message body. The resolved value (all tokens concatenated) must not exceed 5000 characters. This is validated by the service when the Action runs.
